notes.title: I am Deflating
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve decided to lower the price of An Other Golf Game. This wasn’t a quick decision, but one I’ve been thinking about for some time. I’ve spent countless hours building this strange little world, experimenting, writing code, creating systems, and shaping something I thought would be fun, different, and worth sharing. But in the end, the player base has stayed very small, and it’s hard to watch something you’ve poured so much of yourself into remain mostly unseen. I think part of that comes down to accessibility, and for me, that starts with price.[/p][p][/p][p]We live in a time where almost everything is getting more expensive. Food, rent, gas, and even games keep climbing in cost, while corporations raise prices and often offer less in return. People are left with fewer choices, not just for entertainment but for daily essentials. I really don’t want to play into that cycle as it's truly disgusting at its core. If big studios are raising prices to keep up with their costs, perhaps the best way forward for me is to do the opposite. Lowering the price feels like the right move to make the game more accessible to people who might otherwise skip it, and maybe it’s a small way of pushing back against that trend.[/p][p][/p][p]On a personal level, I also have to be honest with myself: I don’t have the same free time I once did. These days I might get an hour or two each week to work on the game, and that makes progress much slower than I’d like. Updates will come, but sadly they won’t be as frequent as the early days when I could dedicate myself fully. This isn’t a studio backed project with a team. It’s just me, working on it when I can. And that’s okay. What matters most to me now is that the work I’ve already put in can reach more players and maybe bring them some enjoyment.[/p][p][/p][p]To those who supported the game early on and paid the higher price: seriously, thank you. I know it’s never fun to see a price drop after you’ve already invested, and I really hope this doesn’t feel like a slight. Your support has truly meant more than you know, and without it, the game wouldn’t have made it this far. My hope is that this change helps grow the community, however small, and keeps the spirit of the game alive.[/p][p][/p][p]Times are tough for everyone, myself included, but I believe accessibility matters more than squeezing every dollar out of the game. Lowering the price isn’t a step back. It’s simply a way to make sure more people have the chance to experience it if they want to.

<3 waxycaps[/p]

notes.title: the future of An Other Golf Game
notes.notes:
[h1][u][b]H E L L O  [/b][/u][b]  [u]E V E R Y O N E   [/u] [/b][/h1][h3]
To keep everyone in the loop, here’s a quick update on the development.[/h3][p][/p][p]Apologies for not being quite as active the last couple months, I have been trying to enjoy some summer weather and also spending some time working on a different weird experimental [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495230/BOXBOYMAN/"]project[/url] in hopes to apply what I learn to An Other Golf Game. [/p][p][/p][p]Below you will find what I have been working on and what's to come. I’ve left out ongoing optimizations and bug fixes, since those are a constant part of development and will continue to receive regular attention.[/p][h2]
[u][b]Active Development (likely this year)[/b][/u][/h2][h3]
[b]Putting Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]The putting system is being completely rebuilt from the ground up allowing for a more natural ball rolling experience. This task has fortunately and unfortunately snowballed quite a bit and to ensure the putting experience is generally better I have been reworking the golf ball physics as well as cleaning up the meshes that make up each hole at the golf course.[/p][p][/p][p]This part of the update is taking up most of the development time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Mini Golf Course[/b][/h3][p]There will be a mini golf course added to the world which should pair nicely with the putting overhaul that's in the works.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Cooking[/b][/h3][p]You'll likely want to cook those raw chickens once the cooking update is in.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Jobs[/b][/h3][p]Currently there are 9 "jobs" in the world, most of which can be found at the golf course. One of the 9 jobs is a 7 part job available from the rat man, and to kick that job off you'll need to find him on Monday. [/p][p]There are a few more golf course related jobs that are in the works, and a few jobs and tasks that will be added that can be found elsewhere.

For some of the new jobs, expect to use the tractor.[b]
[/b][/p][h3][b]Rain[/b][/h3][p]Occasional California downpours are on the way. Weather severity will affect course conditions and shot behavior.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][p]There's a bunch of other things: [/p][list][*][p]Downsizing NPC bones[/p][/*][*][p]Refining the drunk effect [/p][/*][*][p]Adding mushroom effects[/p][/*][*][p]Ball backspin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][u][b]Future Development (next year and beyond)[/b][/u][/h2][h3][/h3][h3][b]Tournament[/b][/h3][p]This is more of the long term goal for the game and one of the most challenging things to try to create in an open world golf sim in which you have to take your own score. I don't expect to have this complete by this year whatsoever. I am hopeful that next year after I tackle the near term goals listed above, I can start to deep dive into the tournament.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More NPCs[/b][/h3][p]Eventually there will be more NPCs roaming around the world, especially playing on the golf course. [/p][p]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who’s jumped into this niche, weird Early Access game, and my first game. Your feedback and bug reports are invaluable and truly make the experience better for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you have feedback, questions, concerns, want to share your experience, or ask me why there is no map at home, I'd love to hear it. Please use the steam forums or check out the discord.[/p][p][/p][p]thanks for your time
-waxycaps
[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Post-Launch Recap
notes.notes:
[h1]Post-Launch Recap: Two Weeks of Fun, Community, and Updates![/h1]

It’s hard to believe it’s already been two weeks since An Other Golf Game launched, or as some of you like to call it, Death Golf! A huge thank you to everyone who has been playing, sharing, and making this journey so incredible. Here’s a quick recap of what’s been happening:


[h3]A Growing Community[/h3]
The community forming around An Other Golf Game has been nothing short of amazing. Whether it’s your creative gameplay strategies, hilarious in-game moments, or heartwarming support in Discord or the discussions, I couldn’t have asked for a better group of players. You’re truly bringing this world to life, and I’m so excited to see it grow even more.


[h3]Community Tournament[/h3]
The first-ever An Other Golf Game Community Tournament is happening now! Thanks again Casual Elephant for setting this up and bringing the community together for some friendly competition. If you haven’t submitted your score yet, it’s not too late. The first tournament closes at the end of this weekend and there will be ongoing community tournaments happening at a regular cadence going forward. Stay tuned for updates and results—may the best golfer win!

Check it out here for more details on how to compete: https://elephante.net/anothergolfgame



[h3]New Beta Branch[/h3]
The beta branch is live! This branch lets you try out experimental updates and give feedback on upcoming features before they go into the main game. Your input has already been incredibly valuable, and I’m working hard to fine-tune the game and of course bring meaningful updates. I am setting up a better way to share what's in these beta branches directly to Steam in an easy way, but for more details you can find information in the Discord.


[h3]Updates[/h3]
Frequent updates are planned throughout the early stages of Early Access, with batch just around the corner—landing in just a few days! You can find details about the upcoming update in Discord, and full patch notes will be shared here on Steam once it goes live.


[h3]Twitch[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047068/85b1e83fbf16015c876cebceab9b0177a3207677.png[/img]

I’ve been blown away by all the incredible Twitch streams and hilarious clips people have been sharing! At one point we had 4,400+ people watching the game be played. It has really been a highlight of these past two weeks. 

Have a great clip of your own? Share it on Discord! I’d love to see it.
https://discord.com/invite/xP9vy5pWp9


[h1]Thank you all again for making this launch such a memorable one. Your support means everything, and I’m so excited to see where we go next, I’m grateful to have you here.[/h1]

notes.title: An Other Golf Game Launches in Early Access This October!
notes.notes:
I’m excited to announce the Early Access launch of An Other Golf Game, coming at the end of October! This isn’t your typical golf game—it’s an immersive, intensely tough experience where golf is only part of the journey. While golf remains at the core, the other challenge is keeping the game going by working odd jobs, managing your money, and finding ways to survive living. Each swing matters, but so does how you navigate the world beyond the course.

In An Other Golf Game, you'll explore a hand-crafted world where making ends meet is just as vital as sinking a perfect putt. Players will need to manage tasks, earn money, and explore their surroundings to keep their ambitions alive. This blend of golf, survival, and life-sim mechanics creates a unique challenge, where staying afloat financially is as important as nailing the perfect shot.

As An Other Golf Game enters Early Access, there will be ongoing adjustments and balancing as I continue fine-tuning the gameplay based on feedback and observations from the community. I think this is just the start of something truly different—there’s nothing quite like it out there. With plenty of exciting updates planned, I’m eager to see where this journey takes us, and I hope the game brings some enjoyment and a few laughs along the way.

Thanks for your time and support,
troy

Tentative Early Access release: October 29th
